svg.metadata: {"story":"Abraham","act":8,"chapter":"Sodom and Gomorrah","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Abram bargains for the cities and Lot escapes as fire and brimstone fall; Lot's wife looks back and becomes a pillar of salt.
